description: This file is a SCSS (SASS) stylesheet, specifically a reboot or normalization style template aimed at resetting and normalizing styles across browsers. It includes resets for box-sizing, typography, form elements, headings, lists, links, tables, and other HTML elements with customization via SCSS variables and mixins. The file is customized for a project likely using OpenCart, given its filename path, but the core content is stylesheet code for browser normalization.
